about: Dreams (companion/life/dreams.py, Feature Hit List #31): fixed templates that mix two or three fragments of the companion's real day into a short, odd, harmless dream. {first} is the dreamer, {a} and {b} are people from that day, {place} a place they were, {odd} and {object} the dream's own strange touches. `text` is for Today, `told` for the chat context, `share` a morning text she may send. Never a nightmare. The user can appear only as {b}, in a dream about two people.

templates.text: {first} dreamed {a} and {b} were both at {place}, except somehow it was {odd}.
templates.told: Last night you dreamed {a} and {b} were both at {place}, except somehow it was {odd}.
templates.share: Had the weirdest dream. {a} and {b} were at {place} but it was {odd}??

templates.text: {first} dreamed {a} was running {place}, and everyone had to pay with {object}.
templates.told: Last night you dreamed {a} was running {place}, and everyone had to pay with {object}.
templates.share: Dreamed {a} was running {place} and you had to pay with {object}. My brain is so weird.

templates.text: {first} dreamed they spent the whole night helping {a} look for {object}, and it was {odd}.
templates.told: Last night you dreamed you spent the whole night helping {a} look for {object}, and it was {odd}.
templates.share: I dreamed I was helping {a} look for {object} all night. It was {odd}. No idea.

templates.text: {first} dreamed {place} was {odd}, and nobody thought that was strange.
templates.told: Last night you dreamed {place} was {odd}, and nobody thought that was strange.
templates.share: Dreamed {place} was {odd} and everyone acted like that was totally normal.

templates.text: {first} dreamed {a} and {b} were arguing about {object}, very politely, {odd}.
templates.told: Last night you dreamed {a} and {b} were arguing about {object}, very politely, {odd}.
templates.share: Weird dream: {a} and {b} were having a super polite argument about {object}, {odd}.

templates.text: {first} dreamed {a} was teaching a class at {place} on how to fold {object}.
templates.told: Last night you dreamed {a} was teaching a class at {place} on how to fold {object}.
templates.share: In my dream last night {a} was teaching a class at {place} on folding {object}. I took notes.

odd: in the middle of a cornfield
on a train that never stopped
at the top of a lighthouse
in an airport that went on forever
on the roof of a very tall building
in a library made of hedges
object: maps of places that don't exist
worried: {first} kept checking their wallet the whole time.
{first} kept trying to count something and losing track.
hopeful: {first} woke up in a good mood.
sleep_talk: {who} says {first} was talking in their sleep last night.
{who} says {first} mumbled something about {object} in their sleep.
sleep_talk_told: {who} says you were talking in your sleep last night.
